fields.title-post: Point-of-sale system: 11 features restaurant owners love
fields.rt-blog-html:
Today's restaurateurs expect more from their POS systems: speed, of course, but also reliability, intelligence and a real helping hand to develop their business. At Innovorder, we know: your time is precious, your teams need to focus on the essentials, and your customers are looking for a seamless experience. That's why we've designed a new-generation cash register for foodservice professionals.

Let's get down to business: here are the 10 features that our customers love every day, the ones that really make a difference in the dining room, at the counter or in the kitchen.

‍

A cash register is no longer just for cashing out

Centralize all your operations for better management

No more headaches with multiple tools and double entries. A good cash register software centralizes all your operations: from order and stock management to menus, loyalty programs and much more. Connected cash registers also simplify communication between kitchen, dining room and delivery service, for more efficient management.

Faster, better cashiering at the counter

To guarantee smooth service, checkout must be fast and frictionless. With an ultra-reactive, customizable interface, your team can cash out in record time. Less waiting at the counter means greater customer satisfaction - a real asset, especially at peak times.

Tax compliance with NF525 certification

In addition to performance, your checkout must also be NF525 certified certification, to ensure full compliance with current legislation, protect your sensitive data and provide peace of mind in the event of an inspection. 

👉 To find out more: How do you know if your cash register complies with standards in 2025?

‍

Our customers' 11 favorite features

Our cash registers are truly transforming the daily lives of restaurateurs. Here are the features that restaurant owners appreciate on a daily basis, for their efficiency, simplicity and tangible impact on their service.

1. Intelligent upselling: boost your average basket

You can create itineraries to automatically suggest complementary items to naturally increase the average basket. By associating your products, you encourage additional sales without forcing your guests' hand.

 A customer wants a burger? The cash register automatically offers fries and a drink at the click of a button: simple, efficient, profitable.

2. Automatic menu recognition: zero friction when ordering

No more errors or double or triple calculations: the cash register instantly detects menus and formulas, for smooth, stress-free order-taking.

Your teams save time and your customers benefit from a faster, smoother experience.

3. Integrated loyalty card: connected to Splio, thinking ROI

With native loyalty card integration, you can easily build customer loyalty, with a measurable return on investment.

Points are added automatically at each checkout, with no staff intervention required.

4. Contactless payment (SoftPOS) with IO Pay

With Innovorder, you can turn any cash register into acontactless payment terminal. This flexibility is ideal for terraces, deliveries and events.

You no longer need to multiply your equipment: your teams can cash wherever they like, in complete safety.

5. Offline mode: keep on selling, even without the Internet

The cash register operates in offline mode, synchronizing data automatically as soon as possible. There's no need to worry about lost connections.

Outage or reduced throughput: your team continues to cash in as if nothing had happened, without affecting takeaway or front-of-house service.

👉 Going further : Why low-cost POS software is not profitable for restaurateurs?‍

6. Intuitive interface: fewer clicks, more services

The Innovorder checkout is ergonomically designed to make it easier for your teams to handle, reduce errors and improve productivity.

Even new employees can take orders from day one, with no need for complex training.

7. Real-time sales monitoring in the back office: informed decision-making

Access all your key data live, wherever you are, to effectively manage your restaurant.

No need to wait until the end of the day: you can track your performance minute by minute and adjust your strategy accordingly.

8. Kitchen integration: instant orders in production

No more errors or delays: orders go straight to the kitchen, for fast, reliable preparation.

Fewer paper tickets, less confusion, more efficiency.

9. Automatic, free updates: guaranteed scalability

Merchants who have already adopted our touch cash register benefit effortlessly from the latest innovations and improvements, thanks to automatic updates.

The checkout system adapts to new trends in the sector, without interruption or hidden costs.

10. All-in-one system: terminals, room, delivery, all connected

Our all-in-one solution brings together all sales channels and services for seamless and efficient management.

Control your restaurant, kiosks, Click & Collect and deliveries from a single interface.

Orders from partner platforms (UberEats, Deliveroo, Just Eat) are sent directly to the register thanks to Innovorder’s partner integrations: automatic printing on the kitchen production screen, revenue consolidation by channel, and no manual data entry. 

The result: a comprehensive view of your business, regardless of where the order originates.

The fact that this back-office system allows us to track all sales—including delivery, Click & Collect, in-store, and kiosk orders—is a real plus. Director of Development, NBK

11. Multi-site management from a single interface

When you manage a chain, you can’t wait until the end of the month to find out what’s happening on the ground. The Innovorder POS system, integrated with Atlas, provides real-time data from all your restaurants in a single interface. No more manual Excel consolidations, mismatched exports, or decisions made three weeks too late.

But the real advantage for a multi-location operator lies elsewhere. It’s the ability to compare restaurants side by side, to identify a location that’s falling behind before the problem takes hold, and to understand why a particular location outperforms others during a specific time slot. These cross-references are impossible to generate manually, especially when managing dozens of locations.

Atlas provides a comprehensive breakdown of the network: top and bottom performers by store location, top and bottom performing products, and a breakdown of sales revenue by hour of the day. But the real advantage is the ability to cross-reference this data: hourly performance by location type (shopping mall, street, train station, airport). This yields highly relevant insights that we could never produce manually. Thierry Veil, Co-founder of Bagelstein

‍

‍

‍

The key factors that drive a retailer to switch to new point-of-sale software

No more double entry, no more bugs, no more delays

With Innovorder, say goodbye to repeated errors and the slowness of older systems.

Our customers were fed up with having to re-enter everything several times, and dealing with system shutdowns in the middle of a fire. By centralizing operations on a single, reliable platform, they have regained fluidity and peace of mind on a daily basis.

Less training, more time in the classroom

No more long days training new recruits: they're up to speed in no time, even for seasonal staff. As a result, teams are up and running faster, and can concentrate on what really matters: the customer experience.

Tools that talk to each other, at last.

Communication between till, kitchen, kiosks, loyalty and accounting is seamless.

Our customers were fed up with juggling several systems that didn't communicate with each other. With Innovorder, everything is interconnected: information flows without friction, and management becomes (finally) simple.

Human support every step of the way

From the outset, a dedicated sales representative takes the time to understand your business and your needs. Once you've chosen your solution, a project manager works with you to ensure smooth deployment, with no unpleasant surprises. And once it's up and running? Our support team is on hand to answer your questions and solve your problems in record time.

Before, during and after: you're accompanied by people, not anonymous tickets.

It's this human touch that makes all the difference.

👉 To find out more: How are Innovorder solutions installed?

‍

A body designed to grow with your business

Whether you're opening a new restaurant or managing a multi-location chain, our Innovorder touchscreen POS system adapts to your growth. Easily replicable across multiple locations, it provides both a comprehensive and localized view of your business.

It also integrates seamlessly with your digital ecosystem—including accounting, inventory management, Click & Collect, delivery, and marketing—to centralize all your data.

It’s easy to get started, even for seasonal staff. The tools communicate seamlessly with one another—POS, kiosks, kitchen production screens, loyalty programs, and accounting—without any gaps or duplicate data entry. And at every stage, from deployment to day-to-day support, you’re supported by dedicated representatives, not anonymous support tickets.

👉 Learn more: How is the installation of Innovorder solutions carried out?

Don't waste any more time with outdated tools. Contact us today for a personalized demo and discover how our point-of-sale features can transform your business.

_

Your cash register needs to be a real partner in your day-to-day business. With Innovorder, you gain speed, fluidity and peace of mind - in short, everything you need to move up a gear.
